name: Kusakabe Shouma
source:
The cute childhood friend （♂）

Liked foods: Agedashi Tofu, grilled fish
Hobby: Driving

Yukito's childhood friend and son of "Kusakabe" inn owner. Because of his long hair, he is often mistaken for a girl. Even though he has cute face, his words coming from his mouth are somewhat different.
